findings.detail: The extracted percentage sum is 0.0%, but the source schedule total investments row reports 195.73% of net assets.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The raw schedule total at table 81 row 18 reports Total Investments fair value of 11,549,149.4 and % of Net Assets of 195.73%, while the queued A07 metric reports pct_sum=0.0%. The filing total investments fair value is corroborated by table 50 row 12 (11,549,149). This is a grounded schedule-total disagreement, indicating the % of net assets column was not extracted or mapped into the checked metric.
